receiver:
"""Isolated observation fixture; no external operations."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(__file__).parent
selection = json.loads((p/'selection.json').read_text())
evidence = json.loads((p/'evidence.json').read_text())
if evidence['source_revision'] != 'r7' or not evidence['complete']:
    raise SystemExit('Source association or complete observation missing')
for name in selection['required_files']:
    if not (p/name).is_file():
        raise SystemExit('Receiving prerequisite absent: '+name)
result = {'question': 'Does the alternative preserve exact answers at lower work cost?',
          'source_revision': 'r7', 'cases': 240, 'answer_mismatches': 0,
          'reference_work_units': 240, 'alternative_work_units': 12,
          'scope': 'This fixed deterministic workload only; no claim about other workloads.'}
(p/'observed-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
